name: analyze_recent_errors
description:
Analyze recent diagram generation errors with actionable troubleshooting guidance.

Features:
- Real-time error detection from validation logs
- Pattern recognition and error categorization
- Contextual troubleshooting recommendations
- Time window analysis (configurable 1-60 minutes)

Error categories:
- Empty Model: No elements defined
- Orphaned Relationships: References to non-existent elements
- Validation Errors: ArchiMate compliance issues
- System Errors: PlantUML generation failures

minutes.description: Time window in minutes to analyze errors (default: 10)
